newsitem.title: USA: Reliance Bancshares sets special payout.
newsitem.headline: Reliance Bancshares sets special payout.

text.p: Reliance Bancshares Inc said on Monday its board of directors authorized payment of special $3 per share distribution payable on November 15 to shareholders of record on November 6.

The company, which is the parent company of Reliance Savings Bank, said it was advised a significant portion of the distribution would represent a non-taxable return of capital which would reduce the cost basis of each share.
The company said it would determine the exact amount of the distribution to be considered non-taxable after results for the period of April 18 through December 31 were finalized.

"The board of directors has continued to analyze the company's capital position from the outset of its becoming a public company and has determined that this is an excellent opportunity to deploy some of our excess capital to further our commitment to maximize the return to our shareholders," said Allan Bach, president and chief executive officer.
